annotator: Actual human operator, watching the original source in full; generated prompts and pose predictions hidden

side.definition: Actual anatomical side visible in the source; never infer from image side or requested prompt

boundary_rule: Select an actual decoded frame PTS; do not reconstruct or round to a nominal frame-rate grid

phases.meaning: Visible starting posture before the arm begins moving away from the body
Visible upper-arm movement away from the starting posture
Observed upper-arm turning point or maintained endpoint; no prescribed healthy range assumed
Visible movement back toward the starting posture
Rest, returned starting posture or another visible activity; unknown spans remain masked

phase_interval.end_inclusion: half-open training interval; original endpoint PTS retained
phase_interval.unobserved_spans: no supervision; never fill from prompts or model outputs

repetition.completed: An observable full raising and lowering process that returns to its visible starting posture; all five ordered boundaries independently confirmed
repetition.partial: An observable incomplete process; amplitude alone is not completeness
repetition.unobservable: Unknown completion and false mask; no invented zero or negative

observable_count.known_zero: Only after full-video viewing confirms no complete target repetition
observable_count.known_positive: Must equal the number of explicitly completed observable repetitions in the full inventory

clinical_quality.requires: Two independent qualified human reviewers and a third adjudicator, with source SHA and review evidence

evaluation_event_semantics.human: Physically visible phase boundary in source media
evaluation_event_semantics.B0: Unchanged ProtocolEngine confirmation event, including original observation and hysteresis delays
evaluation_event_semantics.B2: Causal model phase transition decoded from arrived source frames
evaluation_event_semantics.limitation: Boundary timing differences include estimator confirmation delay; they are not clinical ROM or diagnostic accuracy
